paragraphs.text: 1. I SING thy fame that, Maghavan, through thy Greatness the heavens and earth invoked thee in their terror,
paragraphs.original: तां सु ते कीर्तिं मघवन्महित्वा यत्त्वा भीते रोदसी अह्वयेताम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā yattvā bhīte rodasī ahvayetām |

paragraphs.text: Thou, aiding Gods, didst quell the power of Dasas, what time thou holpest many a race, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: प्रावो देवाँ आतिरो दासमोजः प्रजायै त्वस्यै यदशिक्ष इन्द्र
paragraphs.translit: prāvo devām̐ ātiro dāsamojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yadaśikṣa indra

paragraphs.text: 2. When thou wast roaming, waxen strong in body, telling thy might, Indra, among the people,
All that men called thy battles was illusion: no foe hast thou to-day, nor erst hast found one.
paragraphs.original: मायेत्सा ते यानि युद्धान्याहुर्नाद्य शत्रुं ननु पुरा विवित्से
paragraphs.translit: māyetsā te yāni yuddhānyāhurnādya śatruṃ nanu purā vivitse

paragraphs.text: 3. Who are the Rsis, then, who comprehended before our time the bounds of all thy greatness?
paragraphs.original: क उ नु ते महिमनः समस्यास्मत्पूर्व ऋषयोऽन्तमापुः ।
paragraphs.translit: ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyāsmatpūrva ṛṣayo'ntamāpuḥ |

paragraphs.text: For from thy body thou hast generated at the same time the Mother and the Father.
paragraphs.original: यन्मातरं च पितरं च साकमजनयथास्तन्वः स्वायाः
paragraphs.translit: yanmātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca sākamajanayathāstanvaḥ svāyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Thou, Mighty Steer, hast four supremest natures, Asura natures that may ne'er be injured.
paragraphs.original: चत्वारि ते असुर्याणि नामादाभ्यानि महिषस्य सन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: catvāri te asuryāṇi nāmādābhyāni mahiṣasya santi |

paragraphs.text: All these, O Maghavan, thou surely knowest, wherewith thou hast performed thy great achievements.
paragraphs.original: त्वमङ्ग तानि विश्वानि वित्से येभिः कर्माणि मघवञ्चकर्थ
paragraphs.translit: tvamaṅga tāni viśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi maghavañcakartha

paragraphs.text: 5. Thou hast all treasures in thy sole possession, treasures made manifest and treasures hidden.
paragraphs.original: त्वं विश्वा दधिषे केवलानि यान्याविर्या च गुहा वसूनि ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yānyāviryā ca guhā vasūni |

paragraphs.text: Defer not thou, O Maghavan, my longing: thou, art Director, Indra, thou art Giver.
paragraphs.original: काममिन्मे मघवन्मा वि तारीस्त्वमाज्ञाता त्वमिन्द्रासि दाता
paragraphs.translit: kāmaminme maghavanmā vi tārīstvamājñātā tvamindrāsi dātā

paragraphs.text: 6. To him who set the light in things of splendour, and with all sweetness blent essential sweetness,
paragraphs.original: यो अदधाज्ज्योतिषि ज्योतिरन्तर्यो असृजन्मधुना सं मधूनि ।
paragraphs.translit: yo adadhājjyotiṣi jyotirantaryo asṛjanmadhunā saṃ madhūni |

paragraphs.text: To Indra hath this welcome hymn that strengthens been uttered by the votary Brhaduktha.
paragraphs.original: अध प्रियं शूषमिन्द्राय मन्म ब्रह्मकृतो बृहदुक्थादवाचि
paragraphs.translit: adha priyaṃ śūṣamindrāya manma brahmakṛto bṛhadukthādavāci
